verdict.rationale: cubic covers both halves of the story. The cubic CLI finds bugs in local changes and generates a fix prompt for your coding agent. Its official MCP server lets agents read review findings and triage PR issues, with documented setup for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, VS Code and Gemini CLI. Skills also give agents instructions for handling PR comments. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the handoff works smoothly in practice.
